description: A reusable LSA news / magazine story card: image + heading + summary + link. Derived from the 20+ card instances across the migrated pages (homepage Featured News, More from LSA Magazine, department landing cards).

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.description: Story headline, e.g. "Dean's Note: Future-Proofing LSA Students".

fields.name: summary
fields.label: Summary
fields.description: Short teaser paragraph shown under the title.

fields.name: featuredImage
fields.label: Featured Image
fields.description: DAM asset for the card image. (Migrated cards currently point at external lsa.umich.edu URLs; upload to /content/dam/lsa-umich-eds and reference here.)

fields.name: category
fields.label: Category
fields.description: Optional tag for filtering in listings (fragment-list block).

variations.name: compact
variations.title: Compact
variations.description: Title + link only, no image/summary — for dense listings.
